findings.title: PR description contains Claude Code attribution line
findings.claim: The PR description ends with "🤖 Generated with Claude Code", which violates the user's global instructions forbidding Claude/Anthropic attribution in PR descriptions; the line should be removed.

findings.title: getCassandraLongType change affects all unknown basic types, not just vector elements,…
findings.claim: The change to getCassandraLongType is broader than the PR describes: it applies to every unknown basic type at any nesting depth (list, set, map, tuple, UDT members, and metadata parsed via asVectorType), changing TypeInfo.String() output from custom() to custom(<name>) and making Custom() return the name instead of "". This is probably harmless and arguably better, but nothing in the diff tests this outside the vector path, so a caller comparing type strings or checking Custom() == "" would see an uncovered behavior change.
